reason: A web UI floating panel for browsing 24-hour community topics and popular plugins, with configurable refresh, cached public data, and deep links to source pages.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 中提供可拖拽的悬浮面板，用于浏览社区 24 小时热门话题和热门插件，并支持刷新设置及内容链接。
summaries.en: Adds a draggable floating panel to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI for browsing 24-hour community topics and popular plugins with configurable refresh settings and direct content links.

capabilities: Displays a draggable floating panel in the web UI
Fetches public community and plugin ranking data from external endpoints
Opens linked discussions and plugin repositories in new browser tabs
Persists the floating button position and user configuration across reloads
